An '''unidentified droid model''' was used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]] on [[Tarnoonga/Legends|Tarnoonga]].

==History==
[[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]] had at least two of these droids stationed at his base on the water world of [[Tarnoonga/Legends|Tarnoonga]]. One of the droids worked as part of the crew at the hangar housing Kybo's captured [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], while the other served as a sentry at the entrance to the captain's quarters.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Pirate_Droid_statue.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A statue or deactivated pirate droid on Tarnoonga]]
Functioning droid members of Gir Kybo Ren-Cha's crew appeared only in the book ''[[The Pirates of Tarnoonga: A Droid Adventure]]'' and were not present in the ''[[Pirates of Tarnoonga]]'' television episode. However, statues in Kybo's fortress appear to have the same character design. Whether or not they were actually statues or deactivated droids is not known.
